title: Aerovia project file
description: Contract project 1.0.0: the project file the App exports (Project dialog, and the autosave in local storage under aerovia.project.v1) and imports: the network, the operating options, an optional baseline of inputs only (its result is recomputed on load) and the save time. Written by frontend/src/storage.ts serializeProject and checked there (validatedInputs); also accepted by data-pipeline/aerovia_pipeline/io.py load_networks and project_options for the pipeline. The size limit is 2 MiB (frontend/src/engine/validation.ts LIMITS.fileBytes), checked before parsing. Nothing is committed: the row has no documents.

savedAt.description: An ISO UTC timestamp; the importer rejects an impossible calendar date.
